source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Change all/random setting to non-default in this BIOS function.
3. Save and reboot.
4. Boot in to BIOS and  check your setting still exist.
5. Press load default,save and reboot.
6. Boot in to BIOS,setting in this function should match the SPEC.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. No error log happen.
2. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
3. Check your setting still exist.
4. The default setting should matches SPEC."

original_test_intent: Verify that selected Advanced Trusted Computing settings can be changed to approved non-default values, persist across save/reboot, and return to the platform SPEC defaults after Load Default without security, boot or log failures.
original_method: In BIOS, change settings on the ADVANCE Trusted Computing page, save/reboot and verify persistence; then Load Default, save/reboot and verify every in-scope field against SPEC while checking reboot and logs.
manual_activity: A human must navigate the Trusted Computing page, change each approved field, invoke both save/reboot phases, select Load Default and visually verify the BIOS values. Agent telemetry can support but cannot replace these core UI observations.
required_inputs: Named field, baseline, non-default and SPEC-default matrix
Secure Boot and encrypted-volume recovery material
Console/operator, stable power and OOB recovery
Approved final state and log/health scope
safety_requirements: Never operationalize the source phrase all/random; approval must name every field and value.
Exclude TPM clear/reset/ownership and other irreversible controls unless a separately approved case requires them.
Confirm encrypted-volume recovery and Secure Boot/measured-boot effects before saving.
Preserve the first failure and stop on OS unlock, boot, TPM, security or management loss.
Restore the approved final security state.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only BIOS/TPM/Secure Boot/OS identity, state, logs and health evidence.
Compare operator captures against the approved non-default and SPEC-default matrix.
Do not drive BIOS, choose security values, handle secrets beyond approved evidence, or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Define and approve the bounded field/value matrix and recovery materials.
Perform/capture the non-default persistence and default-restoration phases.
Assess security/boot impact and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects SSH automation for the BIOS control path. The source has no executable command; any OS TPM/Secure Boot tools are read-only supporting checks and platform-specific.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the manual BIOS sequence and use only approved read-only OS/BMC inventory commands selected for the platform; do not use software TPM provisioning or firmware-variable writes as substitutes.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source two-phase sequence, no-script state and 5/20-minute fields are preserved; unsafe all/random wording is retained as source but bounded at execution.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a signed-off matrix of baseline, safe non-default and SPEC-default values; capture each BIOS transition and reboot, correlate TPM/Secure Boot/measured-boot and OS-unlock state, then restore the approved final configuration.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact BIOS/TPM implementation and installed OS security stack.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS, BMC, TPM firmware, OS and evidence-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform Trusted Computing default specification and approved OS encryption/recovery procedures.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces random selection at execution with a bounded owner-approved matrix while preserving the original persistence/default coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; every approved in-scope field receives before/non-default/default evidence, with dangerous controls explicitly dispositioned.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Field matrix, SPEC, recovery material and dependency inventory.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Hidden state and TPM policy changes may require vendor-specific recovery and must not be inferred from one visible setting.

project_override_considerations: The project selects the safe subset or full page matrix and documents exclusions. A reduced approved subset completes only that project plan and must not be reported as proving every page setting or the unbounded original wording.
expected_evidence: Identity, approval, complete security baseline and recovery readiness
First save/reboot and per-field persistence captures
Load Default, second save/reboot and SPEC comparison
TPM/Secure Boot/encryption/boot/management health, logs, final state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently require non-default persistence followed by SPEC-default restoration. The all/random phrase is unsafe and underspecified, but a bounded project matrix preserves the coherent source purpose without choosing a contradictory outcome.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The two-phase intent is clear. Missing fields, SPEC values and recovery materials are readiness requirements and must stop execution, but they do not make the library case permanently BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees with the human BIOS boundary and adds the missing security-specific safety analysis.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its field matrix, encryption/TPM recovery and read-only checks while applying V3.1 readiness rather than permanent block semantics.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates manual core execution, automatable evidence, project scope and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Converts a potentially hazardous random security mutation into a traceable approved matrix without rewriting the Master Source or reducing persistence/default coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: Both decisive observations occur in pre-OS firmware and include human selection of security-sensitive controls, so MANUAL ONLY is required. Supporting software can validate downstream state but cannot establish the BIOS page behavior itself.
no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat a Trusted Computing change, save/reboot or default load after any security, boot or evidence anomaly; preserve the raw state and obtain engineer disposition.
